objective: Make holyagent setup and doctor default to the scope the HolyAgent Claude Code plugin is installed at when --scope is not given, instead of always user.
scope: Worktree: /home/user/holyagent-0.3.0-scope (branch release/0.3.0/feat/installed-scope-default). Work and run every command there.

Today packages/runtime/src/cli/setup.ts:59 and :99 default to "user", and packages/runtime/tests/setup-scope.test.ts:552 asserts that. Claude Code records an install in enabledPlugins of ~/.claude/settings.json (user), .claude/settings.json (project) or .claude/settings.local.json (local), with local over project over user. Resolve the default from where the HolyAgent plugin id is enabled, with that precedence, reusing settingsFile in packages/runtime/src/setup/scope.ts (it resolves the git top-level and refuses symlinks) and the existing settings readers; find the plugin id the repository already uses rather than inventing one. With no entry anywhere, keep user. A file that does not decode is an error naming the file, as elsewhere in setup.
An explicit --scope always wins. Say in setup's and doctor's output which scope was used and, when it was inferred, from which file, so a user is never surprised by where setup wrote.
Update docs/usage.md:131-139, which says this default is planned, to describe the shipped behavior.
constraints: Before anything else, run `bun install --frozen-lockfile` in your worktree, because node_modules is not shared between worktrees; the prepare step installing lefthook hooks is expected.
Make no git writes (no commit, add, checkout, stash, branch) and no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; the root commits. Report your changed paths.

Follow the repository rules in .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the worktree: Effect for effects and errors with tagged errors (no try/catch, new Promise, Promise statics or async functions in runtime and CLI source), Effect Schema at data boundaries with onExcessProperty error, Bun APIs and the Bun Shell, JSDoc on every exported function and type.
Testing is unit tests and recorded or synthesized fixtures only: never start pi, a Pi session, T3 Code or a Kimi request.

Gates, run in your worktree: `bunx --no-install mise run build` (commit-ready generated output; the tree must have no unexplained changes after it) and `bunx --no-install mise run verify` (type-check, lint, format check, tests) must exit 0. Give the command, exit code and test counts.

Write `git diff` of your change (after the build) to a file outside the repository in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-holyagent/43946df6-456d-58c6-bea3-7e958fcb9495/scratchpad and give its path as diff-file evidence.
Build only what the Assignment asks; name any further improvement in the report instead of adding it.
Report in under 400 words; put long logs in a file in the scratchpad above and give its path.

The generated packages/integrations/claude/dist and packages/integrations/pi/dist are rewritten by mise run build; include those regenerated files in your change and changed paths, though they are not listed in your ownership paths (parallel branches in other worktrees regenerate them too).

criteria.text: Without --scope, setup and doctor use local, project or user according to where the plugin is enabled, with local over project over user, and user when it is enabled nowhere, each with a test
An explicit --scope overrides the inferred one, with a test
An undecodable settings file is reported as an error naming the file, with a test
The output names the scope used and the file it was inferred from
mise run build leaves no unexplained changes and mise run verify exits 0
No test is weakened or removed to pass; every new behavior has a test that fails without it
The change stays inside the Assignment's scope and ownership paths
